subject: MedCare security & ID/access kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Santos <esantos@medcare.com>, Rajiv Shah <r.shah@medcare.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: MedCare security & ID/access kickoff

Hi Emily / Rajiv —

Thanks for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the path to procurement and technical kickoff.

Key notes from our discovery
- Business use case: MedCare wants to integrate Redwood inference for clinical triage summarization and patient-facing messaging (PHI in scope).
- Regulatory posture: HIPAA required; GDPR considerations for EU patients. You indicated an existing HIPAA program and in-progress SOC 2 Type II.
- Identity & provisioning: Primary IdP = Okta; SCIM provisioning likely required for groups; RBAC for admin separation is a must.

Redwood asks / risks to validate (priority order)
1) SOC 2 status: snapshot of whether Type II report will be available and expected delivery date.
2) HIPAA: do you have an executed BAA? If not, we can share our standard BAA and DPA for review.
3) Vendor questionnaire: please confirm the right owner to complete your security questionnaire (we can also push our questionnaire to your portal).
4) SSO/SCIM evidence: SAML metadata file (IdP), SCIM test account, and a short note on supported attributes for user provisioning.
5) RBAC/admin controls: list of expected admin roles and whether you need per-tenant isolation for roles.

Proposed next steps (can we agree by EOD Friday?)
- Redwood will: share a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) and our ID/access checklist.
- MedCare to: confirm SOC 2 ETA, provide owner for vendor questionnaire, and confirm IdP admin contact to schedule a technical deep-dive.

Attachments: 20260701-MAP-MedCare.pdf (mutual action plan), redwood-id-access-checklist.xlsx (artifact list)

If that looks right I will lock a 30-min technical deep-dive early next week (requesting Okta admin + security owner + your engineering lead).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. A few notes and owners:
- SOC 2: we are currently undergoing Type II and expect the final report by 2026-10-15 (Q4). We can provide interim controls evidence and the Type I report on request. Owner: Rajiv Shah (cc'd).
- HIPAA: we have a standard BAA template; we do not have one executed for third parties yet for this use case. Please send your BAA and DPA.
- Vendor questionnaire: please upload the vendor questionnaire to our security portal (I'll send a guest link) or feel free to complete the questionnaire we attach. Owner: Rajiv will coordinate.
- SSO/SCIM: Primary IdP = Okta (SAML 2.0). We support SCIM v2 for provisioning. Our Okta admin (me) can provide SAML metadata; engineering contact for SCIM tests is Aisha Gupta (aisha.gupta@medcare.com).
- RBAC: we expect 3 roles initially (Admin, Clinician, ReadOnly). Also want separation between operations and product teams for admin privileges.

Next steps from our side
1) I will upload the vendor questionnaire link by EOD today.
2) Rajiv will share SOC 2 ETA and interim artifacts.
3) Aisha will be available for SCIM test next week; she prefers Wed morning PST.

Please send the BAA and DPA and let's lock the technical deep-dive for Wed 08 Jul 2026 09:00 PST if that works.

Regards,
Emily Santos
Head of IT Security
MedCare Solutions
esantos@medcare.com | +1 206-555-0188
